gen.title: Components and measurement of aerodynamic drag

cards.stem: Which type is listed as part of the drag coefficient makeup
cards.quote: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag, skin friction drag, wave drag, and induced drag components.
cards.hint: Look for what the coefficient bundles together

cards.stem: How is the area symbol in the drag relation characterized
cards.quote: Notice that the area (A) given in the drag equation is given as a reference area.
cards.hint: Recall how the area is labeled in the relation

cards.stem: What facility is typically used to determine drag coefficients
cards.quote: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally using a wind tunnel.
cards.hint: Think about where airflow is controlled for testing

cards.stem: What velocity relation does drag depend on
cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity
cards.hint: Consider how speed enters the dependence
